column3: Anti-clickjacking header missing (we send X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors everywhere)
CSP weaknesses: review each directive (public site may need style-src 'unsafe-inline')
Cookie without HttpOnly (session/csrf cookies must be HttpOnly)
Timestamp disclosure: build timestamps in the static bundle are intentional
Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy / COEP / COOP: review, not required
